acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Snapshot original D3D9Ex pixels for complete and cropped/single-dirty game Presents before any GPU-to-D3D9Ex StretchRect.
Restore original game pixels on a failed first, single or later multi-tile StretchRect; preserve untargeted HUD regions, original rendering, gamepad/FFB and default-off activation.
All five unchanged GitHub Actions succeed at one exact C++/test material SHA.

integration_path: Actual game-authored D3D9 Draw -> native D3D11 full-frame BGRA output
Same-Present full/crop/dirty GPU D3D9Ex StretchRect -> pre-blit original-game tile backups
First/any write failure -> exact original D3D9Ex pixels restored, with original input/FFB retained
batch_components: native_game_shared_desktop.hpp first and single region rollback during real GPU publication
source-linked portable native shared desktop positive/negative regression
